decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement, Planning Statement, CR-B-CHR-100C Rev. A, CR-B-CHR-100D Rev. A, CR-B-CHR-101 Rev. F, CR-B-CHR-121 Rev. A,  CR-B-CHR-200, CR-B-CHR-202 Received: 18 April 2013 Flood Risk Assessment Received: 24 April 2013 Visual Image of Front Elevations, CR-B-CHR-201 Rev. D Received: 31 May 2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 6 - The restaurant shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 8.00am to 11.00pm Monday to Saturday, and 8.00am to 10.00pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays. No customers shall remain on the premises 30 minutes after this time.
Condition : 7 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of [Monday to Saturdays 7am - 11pm and Sundays 9am - 10pm] nor at any time on Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 8 - The rating level of any noise generated by plant & equipment as part of the development shall be at least 10 dB below the pre-existing background level as determined by BS4142: 1997-"Method of rating industrial noise affecting mixed residential and industrial areas".
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and change of use of the basement and ground floors from A1 (Retail) to A3 (Restaurant/Caf?)
